data.title: 因幡巡 · 夏夜凉风中的指尖相扣
data.description: 深夜安静的公寓阳台上，凉爽的夜风吹散了白日的暑气。巡身着轻柔的居家吊带衫，赤足站在木栏杆旁仰望繁星。当少年的手掌轻轻覆上她搭在栏杆边的指尖时，她没有抽离，而是微红着脸翻过手心，坚定地十指相扣。
data.action: interlocking fingers, looking at stars, shy affectionate smile
data.lighting: cool silver moonlight and ambient city glow
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot on the quiet balcony under the stars, Meguru interlocks fingers with the viewer beside the railing; only the viewer's hand is visible. Moonlight softly illuminates her face and orange side ponytail.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the railing, Meguru interlocks fingers with the viewer's hand as it enters the frame.
